title: 528. Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements II

examples.explanation: Equalize at 2: one move raises 1 to 2 and one move lowers 3 to 2.
Equalizing at any value between 2 and 9 costs 16 moves; for example target 5 needs 4 + 5 + 3 + 4 moves.

hints: The total travel distance is minimized by picking a median of the array as the common target.
Sort the array, take the middle element, and add up absolute differences to it.
